label: Beamsplitter cube (50:50)
tooltip: Non-polarizing beamsplitter cube: a single BK7 cube with a thin coated plate NESTED inside along the diagonal (glass-glass interface -- the split table applies exactly; the old two-prism air-gap build TIR'd the transmitted arm at 45 deg and lost ~1/3 of the power to seam loss). Default coating bs_5050_vis_45; swap the plate body's 'coating' property for any bs_XXYY_vis_45 registry row to change the split ratio. Two bodies (cube + splitter plate).
